name: Ted Talks (Alpha)
description: TED Talks are influential videos from expert speakers on education, business, science, tech and creativity
author: FUTO

6: Fix: Some speakers showing no talks;
Fix: Missing talks on speakers with more than 50 talks;
Fix: Missing space in speaker names when searching creators;
Fix: Unclear error when opening an unavailable talk or playlist;
Fix: Internal error when opening a speaker without a public profile;
Fix: Empty Home feed when TED is partly unreachable;
Fix: Temporary errors shown as if a talk or speaker was removed;
Fix: Talks wrongly shown as external content when TED is briefly unreachable;
Fix: Playlist talks not linking to their speaker, and showing a generic image;
Performance: Faster opening of speakers without a public profile;
5: Improvement: Set HLS as priority source;
4: Improvement: Add browser impersonation (HttpImp) for SSL resilience;
Improvement: New web-based home feed that avoids SSL-problematic search API;
3: Fix: Handling external content (podcasts hosted on youtube);
Improvement: Add setting to control external content visibility;
2: Improvement: add support for TED topics as playlists;

settings.name: Show External Content
settings.description: Show content hosted on third party platforms (e.g., YouTube) as nested content that may require another plugin. If no plugin can handle the content it will be opened in the browser.

settings.name: Verbose notifications
settings.description: Show toast notifications for HTTP request details (useful for debugging)

settings.name: Browser Impersonation
settings.description: Use TLS fingerprint impersonation (HttpImp) to bypass bot detection and SSL issues. Disable if you experience connection problems.
